title: The InfoScan Electron desktop client improperly handles TLS certificate errors by accepting… (CVE-2026-117659)
description: The InfoScan Electron desktop client improperly handles TLS certificate errors by accepting untrusted certificates without proper validation. Additionally, the client is configured with insecure Electron settings such as nodeIntegration enabled, contextIsolation disabled, and webSecurity disabled, which weaken its security boundaries. This vulnerability allows an attacker capable of intercepting or manipulating network communications to present an untrusted certificate and potentially compromise the application's security.
